name: trello
description: Ask Claude about, and act on, your Trello boards, lists, and cards through Atlassian's hosted Trello MCP server (mcp.trello.com). Authentication is an Atlassian account login in your browser through /mcp; no API key, token, client ID, or secret to create. The server grants read and write scopes, so Claude can change boards once you approve a call. Includes card-first: before new work starts, find or create the matching card and keep it updated.
